from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import base64
import hashlib
import json
import os
import tarfile
from pathlib import Path

import httpx2

from judgmentllm.config import RunSpecV3
from judgmentllm.execution import execute_run
from judgmentllm.persistence.hashing import canonical_bytes
from judgmentllm.preparation import prepare_run
from judgmentllm.production_transport import production_context
from judgmentllm.providers.openai import OpenAIAdapter

ROOT = Path('/tmp/issue56-history-pending')
os.chdir(ROOT)
Path('responses.jsonl').write_text('{"item_id":"001","text":"Synthetic seed grows."}\n')
os.environ['OPENAI_API_KEY'] = 'SYNTHETIC_HISTORY_ONLY'

async def produce():
    for cache in ('auto', 'off'):
        for capture in ('full', 'minimal'):
            run_id = f'{cache}-{capture}'
            spec = RunSpecV3.model_validate({
                'task_kind':'rubric', 'input':Path('responses.jsonl'),
                'provider':'openai', 'endpoint':'responses', 'model':'gpt-6-luna',
                'prompt':{'structured_output':'text'}, 'capture':capture,
                'execution':{'cache_policy':cache, 'concurrency':1},
                'rubric':{'rubric_id':'01','name':'Synthetic','traits':[
                    {'trait_id':'01','name':'Clarity','description':'Synthetic.',
                     'levels':[{'label':'low'},{'label':'high'}]}]},
            })
            Path(f'{run_id}.json').write_bytes(canonical_bytes(spec))
            with prepare_run(spec, store='store', run_id=run_id,
                capabilities=OpenAIAdapter.capabilities_for('openai','responses',spec.model),
                transport_context=production_context(spec)) as prepared:
                dependency = next(prepared.iter_request_dependencies())
                receipt = next(prepared.repository.iter_attempts(run_id))
                wire = prepared.prepare_transport_attempt(dependency,
                    prepared.transport_for_attempt(receipt.attempt_id).identity)
                Path(f'{run_id}-payload.bin').write_bytes(wire.payload)
                Path(f'{run_id}-receipt.json').write_bytes(canonical_bytes(wire.transport_commitment))
                assert b'prompt_cache_options' not in wire.payload
            if False:
                def respond(request):
                    return httpx2.Response(200,json={
                        'id':'resp-history','object':'response','status':'completed','model':'gpt-6-luna',
                        'output':[{'type':'message','role':'assistant','content':[
                            {'type':'output_text','text':'{"scores":[{"trait_id":"01","category_label":"high"}]}'}]}],
                    },request=request)
                adapter=OpenAIAdapter('responses',spec.model,http_transport=httpx2.MockTransport(respond))
                def fault(point, request):
                    if point=='after_evidence_commit':
                        raise RuntimeError('Synthetic interruption')
                try:
                    await execute_run(run_id,store='store',spec=spec,adapter=adapter,fault=fault)
                except ExceptionGroup:
                    pass
                assert adapter.actual_call_count == 1

asyncio.run(produce())
archive=Path('/tmp/issue56-history.tar.gz')
with tarfile.open(archive,'w:gz') as tar:
    for path in sorted(ROOT.rglob('*')):
        if path.is_file():
            tar.add(path,arcname=str(path.relative_to(ROOT)),recursive=False)
Path('/tmp/issue56-history.base64').write_text(base64.b64encode(archive.read_bytes()).decode()+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'source_commit':'34dd83f','sha256':hashlib.sha256(archive.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'bytes':archive.stat().st_size}))
